title: Creamy Thai Biryani with Seared Foie Gras
description: A rich and creamy Thai biryani dish topped with seared foie gras, perfect for a luxurious dinner.
instructions: Heat butter in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add lemongrass and cook for 1 minute.
Add biryani masala and unique spice blend. Cook for 1 minute.
Add basmati rice and cook for 2 minutes.
Add heavy cream and stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and cover.
Simmer for 18-20 minutes or until rice is cooked.
Heat a skillet over high heat.
Sear foie gras for 1-2 minutes on each side, or until cooked to desired temperature.
Slice foie gras into thin pieces.
Garnish with cilantro and serve over biryani.
